items.title: UMG says 68% of listeners want a 'kill switch' for AI music
items.excerpt: UMG published its own listener research days after Deezer's survey: 68% say they want a 'kill switch' to filter AI music out of streaming, well above Deezer's 41% figure.

items.title: Agentic AI in music marketing: 'superhumans', safeguards and 7am inbox briefs
items.excerpt: Music marketers describe moving from chatbot prompting to agentic AI workflows: automated morning briefs, campaign agents and the safeguards teams are putting around them.

items.title: Tim Minchin lights up ARIA awards with minute-long AI blast
items.excerpt: Tim Minchin used a minute on the ARIA Awards stage to attack AI companies training on artists' work, as Australia's creative sector campaigns against copyright reforms favouring AI firms.

history_match.title: ARIA and PPCA launch 'Not AI's to Take' campaign for permission-first AI copyright rules in Australia

items.title: iZotope launches AI-powered stem separation and audio enhancement plug-in, Photon
items.excerpt: iZotope's new Photon plug-in uses AI to split mixes into stems and restore audio, including taming outdoor wind, traffic and indoor room noise.

history_match.title: iZotope Photon is a local stem separation and denoising tool that runs off your GPU

items.title: sonible Releases pure:smooth, an AI-Powered Resonance Suppression Plugin
items.excerpt: sonible has released pure:smooth, an AI-powered dynamic resonance suppressor that tames harsh resonances with minimal controls, joining its pure: line of simplified smart plugins.

items.title: Neutone announces Terra - Neural Drum Synth with Map-Based Exploration (AU & VST3)
items.excerpt: Neutone released Terra in early access: a neural drum synth where each 'map' is a continuous latent space for exploring analogue and digital drum sounds and variations.

items.title: EU member states call for more AI copyright protections and European ownership for TikTok Europe
items.excerpt: As EU culture ministers met in Brussels, eleven member states backed stronger copyright protections against AI training, alongside a German-Austrian push for European ownership of TikTok Europe.

items.title: Australian music industry rejects 'divide and conquer' proposal to give musicians exemption from AI scraping
items.excerpt: A reported government proposal to exempt musicians alone from AI text-and-data-mining was called 'unworkable' by ARIA's chief executive, who said the industry won't be split from other creatives.

history_match.title: ARIA and PPCA launch 'Not AI's to Take' campaign for permission-first AI copyright rules in Australia

items.title: How Many Streams Are AI Tracks Actually Generating on DSPs?
items.excerpt: New data suggests most fully AI-generated uploads receive zero plays on DSPs, with AI audio generating relatively few streams and a modest fanbase despite the upload flood.

items.title: Tencent Music says AI content streams are 'negligible' as it takes legal action over AI infringement
items.excerpt: Tencent Music Entertainment says streams of AI-generated content are negligible and declining as a share of listening, while it pursues legal action over AI infringement.

items.title: UMG and Sony withdraw DistroKid subpoena motion in Suno case after distributor produces AI-detection documents
items.excerpt: The labels dropped their motion after DistroKid produced data on how many uploads it flagged as AI-generated, how many were attributed to Suno, and what they earned.

history_match.title: Nvidia Moves to Quash Burdensome UMG v. Suno Subpoena

items.title: How Contocracy and AI Could Keep an Artist-Founded Label Sounding Like Its Founder
items.excerpt: A thought experiment featuring a fictional artist-founded record label, its founder, and how contocracy and AI could help future leadership keep the label sounding like its founder.

items.title: Hive Launches AI Assistants to Help Venues and Promoters Sell More Tickets
items.excerpt: Hive's new AI assistants draft email and SMS campaigns for live-event marketers, automating preparation so teams can focus on strategy, creative and fans.

items.title: Harmonic Circuit: Chord Progression Lies in a Sparse Principal Information Flow in Symbolic Music Models
items.excerpt: Applies mechanistic-interpretability circuit discovery to symbolic music models, finding that chord-progression behaviour runs through a sparse principal information flow inside the network.
